retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic layout featuring a small vessel on a vast, vibrant blue ocean under a clear sky with large-scale expressive typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-action nautical scene where a small outrigger boat crests a large, textured wave, set against a bright blue sky with soft clouds and distant tropical islands. The composition is anchored by a massive, stylized title in the upper third and detailed character action in the center.
coreVisualRelationships: The boat's diagonal mast points toward the top-left title block
The curve of the wave mirrors the organic shapes in the typography
Distant islands provide a sense of scale and destination
The high horizon line emphasizes the depth and texture of the water
coreInvariants: Vibrant cerulean and turquoise water palette
Dynamic water spray and foam textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A small boat with a sail is centered horizontally, positioned in the lower-middle ground to allow the ocean to dominate the bottom half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white, stylized title at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the title, follows the mast down to the characters on the boat, then sweeps across the wave crest to the distant islands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper sky area provides ample breathing room for the title and secondary text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm ochre and terracotta (boat sail and character skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues with high value in the whites for a clean, sunny appearance.

letterConstructionRules: Tapered stroke ends resembling carved wood or bone
Varied baseline for a rhythmic, hand-drawn feel
Heavy weight with slight internal texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letter features a prominent spiral 'hook' or 'wave' motif
Terminals are sharp and angled like nautical tools
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly expressive, illustrative main title paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, tribal-inspired aesthetic of the original
Clean geometric support for metadata text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic 3D render of a small wooden outrigger boat with a triangular sail cresting a large turquoise ocean wave. In the background, show a clear blue sky with soft white clouds and distant lush green islands. Ensure the top third of the sky is clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, white, custom-lettered title in the upper center with a slight arch. Add small, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif text at the very top and bottom edges in white.

verificationChecks: Is the water texture detailed with foam and spray?
Does the main title have the characteristic spiral and tapered ends?
Is the color palette dominated by vibrant blues and whites?
Is the metadata text legible and properly tracked?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is cut off by the frame
Check that the boat feels grounded in the water
Verify the white text has enough contrast against the sky
Confirm the spiral motif is present in the display type
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Vibrant Ocean Scene] + [Centered Outrigger Boat] + [Large Stylized White Title] + [Wide-Tracked Sans-Serif Metadata]
